gloss: to leap; to jump; (of the heart) to pound with excitement

definitions.explanation: To jump or bounce up, of a body or of things that seem alive: fish leaping in a net, letters jumping off the page ({文字|もじ}が{躍|おど}る).

definitions.gloss: to pound with excitement; to thrill
definitions.explanation: Of the heart or feelings: to beat fast with joy or anticipation, as in {胸|むね}が{躍|おど}る and {心躍|こころおど}る.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紙面|しめん}→紙面：31874_shimen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{見出|みだ}し→見出し：04440_midashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{躍|おど}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Big headlines leap off the page.

examples.japanese: ⟦{網|あみ}→網：22587_ami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{釣|つ}り{上|あ}げた→釣り上げる：17857_tsuriageru⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧アジ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{勢|いきお}いよく→勢いよく：26093_ikioiyoku⟧{躍|おど}った。

⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{躍|おど}って⟦{眠|ねむ}れない→眠れる：15166_nemureru⟧。
examples.english: When I think about the trip that starts tomorrow, my heart races and I can't sleep.

notes:
WRITING:
{躍|おど}る and ⟦{踊|おど}る→踊る：01250_odoru⟧ are the same word in origin. ⟦{踊|おど}る→踊る：01250_odoru⟧ is dancing to music; {躍|おど}る is leaping, and is the usual spelling for ⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{躍|おど}る and {心躍|こころおど}る. Some writers use ⟦{踊|おど}る→踊る：01250_odoru⟧ there too.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{躍|おど}る: one's heart leaps
- {心躍|こころおど}る: thrilling, exciting
- ⟦{文字|もじ}→文字：03632_moji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{躍|おど}る: letters jump off the page (bold headlines)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{躍動|やくどう}→躍動：15944_yakudou⟧: lively motion
- ⟦{活躍|かつやく}→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧: active role, success
